About the Doctor

Meet Your Recovery Expert

BPTMPT (Neuro)MIAP CDNTIASTMCMCTCKPT

Dr. Gobinath S is a highly qualified Consultant Physiotherapist with postgraduate specialisation in Neurological Physiotherapy. With seven advanced certifications, he brings a rare depth of expertise to every patient — at the clinic or your home.

At Physio Time Rehabilitation Centre, we combine evidence-based manual therapy, modern electrotherapy, and personalised exercise science to help you move better, recover faster, and live pain-free.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about physiotherapy at Physio Time Rehabilitation Centre, Sriperumbudur.

Physio Time Rehabilitation Centre is the leading physiotherapy clinic in Sriperumbudur. We offer expert neuro physiotherapy, sports injury rehab, back pain, knee pain treatment and home care by Dr. Gobinath S, BPT, MPT (Neuro).
Yes! We offer home physiotherapy visits across Sriperumbudur and surrounding areas. Post-surgery patients, stroke patients, elderly and bedridden patients especially benefit. Call 80988 89505 or WhatsApp 93616 64064 to book.
We are open Monday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM — including weekends and public holidays. No need to take time off work; evening and weekend slots are always available.
We treat back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain, knee pain, sciatica, arthritis, sports injuries, stroke rehabilitation, neurological conditions, Parkinson's, cerebral palsy, post-surgery recovery, posture correction, pelvic floor issues and more — over 50 conditions in total.
You can book by calling 80988 89505, WhatsApp at 93616 64064, or using the booking form on this page. Same-day appointments are often available. Walk-ins are also welcome during clinic hours.
The number of sessions depends on your condition and severity. After a thorough initial assessment, Dr. Gobinath will give you a clear, personalised treatment plan including expected duration. Most acute conditions show significant improvement in 6–12 sessions.
